title: MineSentials
description: The ultimate collection of mods that Mojang forgot to include in the game lol.
body:
# 🚀 Welcome to MineSentials!

**MineSentials** is a complete modpack focused 100% on the client-side. This means you can join absolutely ANY vanilla server or single-player world without altering the original game mechanics in any way. It only serves to improve your visual and performance experience!

---

### ✨ What does this modpack offer?

* 🛠️ **Performance and Optimization:** Hand-picked mods to make your Minecraft run smoothly, with high FPS, reducing lag and optimizing memory usage.

* 🎨 **Stunning Visuals and Graphics:** Optimized texture packs and integrated shaders ready to use, making blocks, lighting, and water incredibly realistic.

* 📦 **Interface and Utilities:** Visual and user interface (UI) mods that bring more practicality to your inventory and gameplay in everyday life.

---

### 🌐 Partnerships and Credits

This project is maintained with great care and has the support of incredible partners:

* 💻 **Developed by:** [Nickzindev](https://github.com/nickzindev)
* 🌌 **Official Hosting and Partnership:** [GalaxHost](https://galaxhost.com) — The best servers for you to play with your friends without lag!

Download now, activate the included shaders and enjoy the definitive version of Minecraft Client-Side!
